name: Agency Home with Signature Stage
sequence: identity thesis -> signature stage -> services/capabilities -> selected work -> proof -> contact
use_when: agency/brand studio needs memorable identity and proof
notes: Keep spectacle bounded and route to work

name: Editorial Agency Case Detail
sequence: project premise -> context/problem -> intervention -> large media chapters -> outcomes -> reflection -> next project/contact
notes: Avoid uniform feature-card case pages

name: Portfolio Home + Featured Work
sequence: identity -> about signal -> featured works -> service/value signal -> contact
notes: One expressive signature plus readable work list

name: Reflective Portfolio Case
sequence: problem -> intervention -> result -> tradeoffs -> what changes next -> learning
notes: Persistent rail optional on desktop

name: Developer Product Home
sequence: editorial hero -> code/product proof -> DX capabilities -> test/webhooks/editor -> contact/broadcast -> framework proof -> CTA
notes: Evidence precedes broad claims

name: Developer Product -> Docs Bridge
sequence: product claim -> minimal implementation example -> deeper docs/action -> related capability
notes: Keep code truthful and copy short

name: World-Led Launch Journey
sequence: world hero -> trailer -> premise/story -> characters/world chapters -> media/exploration -> news -> back-of-box -> conversion/outro
notes: One campaign job per chapter

name: Evidence-First Directory Home
sequence: scope/thesis -> quick provider summary -> compare/directory entry -> methodology/confidence -> FAQ/glossary
notes: Make confidence/provenance visible

name: Directory Browse Route
sequence: filters/scope -> dense list/table -> freshness/confidence -> methodology link -> detail navigation
notes: Density high but outer layout stable

name: Comparison Route
sequence: comparison controls -> horizontally contained matrix -> evidence/freshness -> methodology -> selected detail actions
notes: Internal horizontal scroll is acceptable

name: One-Record Data Detail
sequence: identity -> key metrics -> evidence/provenance -> caveats -> alternatives -> update/freshness -> compare action
notes: Do more than repeat directory row

name: Enterprise AI Operational Home
sequence: enterprise thesis -> model/context proof -> workspace -> knowledge/context -> pipeline -> use cases -> pricing -> FAQ -> CTA
notes: Operational pipeline carries product explanation

name: Enterprise Trust Satellite System
sequence: home core -> integrations -> pricing -> company -> blog -> careers -> contact/demo -> FAQ -> legal/privacy
notes: Do not duplicate home everywhere

name: Agent SaaS Conversation-to-Action Home
sequence: agent claim -> shared platform -> conversation-to-action proof -> systems/integrations -> changelog -> outcomes -> pricing -> FAQ -> testimonials/content -> CTA
notes: Show action/result, not chat alone

name: Agent SaaS Content + Trust Routes
sequence: blog/changelog -> detail -> related content -> conversion; legal/support routes stay simple
notes: Quarantine demo/template residue

name: AI Service Commercial Core
sequence: hero -> why choose -> feature/tool value -> services -> numbered process -> results -> testimonials -> pricing -> comparison -> FAQ -> CTA
notes: Keep most commercial teaching on one page

name: AI Service Trust Satellites
sequence: commercial core -> contact -> privacy -> changelog -> changelog details
use_when: small service site needs support routes
notes: Avoid many thin duplicate marketing pages

name: Game Studio Home
sequence: world/studio hero -> studio thesis -> services -> cases -> awards/trust -> insights -> app/contact CTA
notes: Studio/company is product, not a single title

name: Game Studio Service Family
sequence: service index -> service detail -> capability/process -> related cases -> contact
notes: Pair every capability family with proof

name: Game Studio Case Family
sequence: case index -> case detail -> project context -> visual stages -> outcome/process -> related cases
notes: Sticky project stages only when readable

name: Immersive Single-Route Journey
sequence: entry gate -> weighted chapters -> event peaks -> payoff -> delayed coda/replay
notes: One authoritative progress domain

name: AI SaaS Dense Commercial Home
sequence: hero -> trust -> how it works -> features -> solution -> stats -> agent/tool proof -> content -> cases -> pricing -> integrations -> testimonials -> FAQ -> CTA
notes: Use operational micro-scenes to avoid abstract bloat

name: Integration Index by Job Taxonomy
sequence: integration thesis -> category taxonomy -> connector list -> related proof/CTA
notes: Categories reflect user jobs

name: Integration Detail as Implementation Proof
sequence: identity/job -> introduction -> capabilities -> installation -> setup metadata -> setup action -> sales fallback -> related integrations
notes: All fields must bind to same connector record

name: Outcome-Structured Case Study
sequence: hero/client -> challenge -> solution/implementation -> quantified outcomes -> related cases -> CTA
notes: Verify metrics and hero/body identity

name: Editorial Blog Family
sequence: blog index -> featured/recent -> article metadata -> long-form body -> related -> conversion
notes: Run duplicate-content canary across family

name: Compressed Pricing Decision Route
sequence: pricing thesis -> plans -> proof/comparison -> testimonial/FAQ -> CTA
notes: Keep page shorter than product home

name: Legal / Policy Trust Route
sequence: document identity/date -> legal sections -> contact/footer
notes: No template placeholders or stale domains

name: Branded 404 Recovery
sequence: clear error -> recovery action -> optional brand cue -> footer
notes: Do not give 404 equal design weight to core routes

name: Whimsical World Portfolio Home
sequence: identity -> teach world vocabulary -> featured collection -> case proof -> taxonomy -> evolution proof -> world map -> truthful stats/achievements -> service quests -> process -> about/origin -> logbook -> contact/save point
use_when: a personal/studio portfolio uses one coherent fictional/collectible system to organize real work and services
notes: teach how to read the metaphor early; keep real role and navigation visible

name: Mnemonic Collection Index
sequence: collection thesis -> numbered/typed records -> mnemonic identity + real project cue -> direct detail action -> contact
use_when: a compact body of work benefits from collection memory and browsing
notes: critical metadata cannot live only on hover/flip back faces

name: Mnemonic Case Detail
sequence: mnemonic title/number/type -> premise -> client/year/scope/result -> brief -> intervention -> outcome -> related/evolved records -> contact
use_when: a creative case study needs memorable identity plus conventional professional evidence
notes: use one meaningful H1 even if display treatment visually resembles a section title

name: World Taxonomy Detail
sequence: real category title -> short promise -> world/category identity -> related work/index action -> all categories -> contact
use_when: discipline/category routes are navigational taxonomy surfaces rather than full sales pages
notes: category label must remain semantic text, not only color or emblem

name: Themed Productized Service Detail
sequence: themed service title -> plain outcome -> price/range -> duration -> approach -> deliverables -> primary action -> all services -> contact
use_when: small creative service offers have fixed or bounded scope
notes: metaphor never replaces price/timing/deliverable clarity

name: One-Page Game Studio Home
sequence: hero -> scale proof -> media reset -> services -> featured games -> character/world art -> testimonials -> FAQ -> team -> contact -> final trust -> footer
use_when: compact game studio/service marketing can support one complete decision journey
notes: split into route families when cases/services need deep proof or search intent

name: One-Page Studio 404 Recovery
sequence: clear error -> return home -> essential anchors -> footer
use_when: single-route marketing still needs branded recovery
notes: return real HTTP 404; keep utility route out of sitemap unless intentionally indexable

name: Single-Title Atmospheric Game Campaign
sequence: hero -> trailer -> premise -> world survey -> story -> gameplay -> systems -> recovered footage -> character -> sound -> release -> press -> final wishlist
use_when: one narrative game title needs a complete marketing journey without multi-route depth
notes: every chapter needs one proof/decision job; quarantine fictional claims and placeholder external destinations

name: Agency Service Narrative
sequence: sticky thesis -> context -> process/capabilities -> proof -> case -> FAQ -> contact
use_when: agency has multiple adjacent services with distinct buyer questions
notes: reuse grammar; bind proof and capability copy to each service

name: Agency Audience Landing
sequence: audience promise -> social proof -> category thesis -> fit -> relevant cases -> ways to work -> FAQ
use_when: same offer must speak credibly to distinct buyer contexts
notes: avoid thin keyword doorway pages

name: Agency Work Directory
sequence: intro -> filters -> media-rich project directory -> testimonials -> contact
use_when: portfolio contains enough work to justify selection/filtering
notes: media is enhancement; project identity/action stays textual

name: Agency Case Study ? Variable Depth
sequence: case facts -> authored evidence modules -> outcome/testimonial -> related work
notes: do not pad legacy/thin cases to flagship length

name: Agency Long-Form Article
sequence: article metadata -> long-form body + desktop outline -> related content -> footer
use_when: thought leadership benefits from deep readable structure
notes: outline releases on mobile

name: Developer Tool Setup Detail
sequence: tool promise -> copy -> place -> configure -> publish staging -> verify -> demo -> CTA
use_when: small integration/tool needs exact install guidance
notes: finish with testable verification

name: Developer Product Feature Evidence
sequence: specific capability promise -> inspectable code/UI/log/flow -> operational trust -> CTA
use_when: feature value has inspectable product state
notes: bind demo to actual feature job

name: Developer Stack Landing Adapter
sequence: stack promise -> SDK snippet -> setup -> ecosystem proof -> CTA
use_when: many developer stacks need organic and actionable entry routes
notes: do not invent executable syntax

name: Developer Provider Migration
sequence: competitor promise -> code converter -> concept mapping -> SDK/API/webhook mapping -> migration CTA
use_when: competitor switching has concrete technical friction
notes: allow side-by-side textual comparison, avoid unverifiable superiority

name: Three-Rail API Documentation
sequence: fixed header + left tree -> internal article scroll with code/parameter tables -> sticky right outline
use_when: hundreds of reference and troubleshooting documents
notes: test nested scroll/keyboard/anchors

name: Developer Release Timeline
sequence: dated sticky rail -> release cards -> detail with code or UI evidence -> product paths
notes: paginate heavy feed

name: Public Company Operating Handbook
sequence: oversized editorial index -> department wayfinding -> detailed process principles -> people/role paths
notes: avoid generic values copy and expose no private data

name: Human Attribution Profile
sequence: person identity -> authored posts/releases -> adjacent team/community paths
notes: do not use invented biographies

name: Developer Usage and Plan Comparison
sequence: plans -> pay-as-you-go -> add-ons -> category-by-category feature comparison
use_when: developer service charges by usage and capabilities
notes: keep units/limits explicit

name: Game Commerce Homepage
sequence: genre identity -> brand proof -> featured game card selection -> categories -> store CTA
use_when: game storefront combines editorial and checkout
notes: bound media; keep featured products actionable

name: Shareable Game Category
sequence: category title -> scoped game cards -> price/cart and product detail
notes: never expose off-domain sample data

name: Game Product Purchase + Lore
sequence: product media -> title/price -> quantity/cart -> description/lore -> related games
notes: purchase affordance above long content; preserve real accessibility

name: Gaming News and Story Archive
sequence: news index -> category -> detail/sections -> related stories
use_when: gaming brand builds audience with articles
notes: maintain real authored content and related category links

name: Membership Pricing Separate from Game Cart
sequence: membership promise -> plan tiers -> CTA; game buying remains separate
use_when: both subscriptions and products are for sale
notes: do not conflate recurring tiers with one-off items

name: AI Content Productivity Homepage
sequence: hero -> problem/counters -> task proof triad -> screenshots -> teams -> comparison -> proof -> pricing -> FAQ -> contact
use_when: all-in-one AI productivity product with contact-first conversion
notes: long marketing journey requires verified claims and coherent CTA

name: SaaS Qualified Contact Form
sequence: promise -> required first/last/email/subject/message; optional company/newsletter -> feedback
use_when: marketing uses form instead of self-service checkout
notes: clarify CTA and completion state

name: Passwordless Email Sign-in or Signup
sequence: shared shell -> email field -> verification request -> OTP destination
notes: type=email; autocomplete; secure delivery and rate limit are external security requirements

name: One-Time Code Entry
sequence: verified context -> OTP code field -> submit -> success/error -> session routing
notes: OTP format, expiration and lockout are not proven by template

name: Compact Account Profile Settings
sequence: authenticated identity -> name/email -> save + status feedback
notes: rendered page alone does not establish session authorization

name: Policy and Error Support Routes
sequence: legal title -> sectioned readable policy -> contact; 404 error -> return to home
use_when: public SaaS needs readable legal and recovery states
notes: don’t reuse template policy as binding legal terms

name: Light Finance SaaS Home
sequence: financial pain -> dashboard evidence -> goals/benefits -> plans -> education -> FAQ -> CTA
notes: real security/money claims need source proof

name: Financial Feature Deep Dive
sequence: benefit -> workflow screenshot -> feature details -> CTA
notes: show real data state not generic filler

name: Financial Integration Directory
sequence: partner overview -> named partner cards -> detail routes
notes: listing is not actual provider connection

name: Scoped Provider Integration Page
sequence: partner identity -> benefit -> scope -> real connect or learn path
notes: OAuth/scopes only if live functionality

name: Finance App Install Portfolio
sequence: app family -> app purpose/platform -> exact store listing
notes: no generic store home badges

name: Financial Education Library and Article
sequence: article cards -> topical article/H2/H3 -> further reading
notes: cite and review financial accuracy

name: Team Profile to Open Role
sequence: about -> named team profile -> distinct job H1/requirements -> real apply
notes: hardcoded unrelated role is a CMS defect

name: Template Sales Overview Separate from Product
sequence: template included-pages index -> vendor template checkout apart from consumer route
notes: do not expose publisher checkout as user financial subscription

name: Agent Workspace Product Home
sequence: product thesis -> sample mode workbench -> voice -> community -> suite -> plans -> install
notes: Mark simulated work as samples

name: Role-Led Three-Mode Product
sequence: Agent routines -> Code terminal/browser -> Thread reading -> download
notes: Show actual job of each mode

name: Speech Privacy and Model Detail
sequence: no-mic sample -> local/cloud paths -> model choices -> languages -> FAQ -> download
notes: Don't claim live microphone in sample

name: Spatial Agent World Story
sequence: tower -> workspace floors -> agent desk -> terminal -> assistant -> install
notes: Marketing stills are not live site WebGL

name: First-Party Credits versus BYO Price
sequence: Basic/Pro/Ultra -> billing period -> credits -> outside model costs -> account
notes: Avoid hidden provider fees

name: Learning and Developer News
sequence: learn index -> dated archive -> article -> primary sources -> related guides
notes: Do not treat site news as independent release proof

name: Cross-Product Release Archive
sequence: product rail -> platform filter -> version/date list -> deep-linked release detail
notes: Keep historical links permanent

name: Documentation Companion Workflow
sequence: getting started -> Agent/Code/Chat -> skills/routines/dictation -> OS guides
notes: Verify public platform copy parity

name: Pricing to Branded Account
sequence: selected plan -> login/signup -> social/email -> consent -> paid continuation
notes: Auth and payment unverified by public page rendering

name: Editorial Agency Membership Home
sequence: subscription hook -> brand manifesto -> selected work/reel -> service lanes -> benefit proof -> on-page membership -> FAQ/testimonials -> contact
notes: One signature stage supported by seven case routes

name: Agency Philosophy and Recognition
sequence: point of view -> principles -> process -> awards/example -> team -> consultation
notes: Avoid copying template awards as real proof

name: Project Discovery Archive
sequence: featured projects -> project name/client/date/type -> search/category -> detailed case
use_when: seven or more meaningful agency projects
notes: Search category must affect visible result state

name: Long-Form Creative Case Detail
sequence: hero/metadata -> Overview -> Challenge -> Solution -> Results -> Reflection -> Credits -> related work
notes: Outcomes and client identity require real sources

name: Agency Journal Archive
sequence: author/date/topic index -> search -> article -> newsletter
notes: Author labels and search must be accurate

name: Agency Editorial Deep Read
sequence: article title/byline -> thesis -> images/chaptered ideas -> takeaways -> related reading
notes: Do not fabricate metrics

name: Embedded Agency Subscription Offer
sequence: services -> Core/Pro switching -> monthly queue/caveat -> membership CTA -> project form
notes: Do not invent /pricing or copy seller's checkout

name: Creative Service and Budget Intake
sequence: project service -> budget -> required name/email/message -> calendar/chat/mail alternatives -> FAQ
notes: Retain CTA service context and real outbound URLs
